sources.entry: Hive-Pal - Mobile-first beekeeping management app for tracking hives, inspections, queen records, and equipment with streamlined data entry optimized for field use. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Hive Pal is a self-hostable, mobile-first beekeeping management web app for tracking apiaries, hives, inspections, queens, harvests and equipment.
summary.what_it_does: Hive Pal lets beekeepers record and manage apiaries (with location and weather info), hives and their boxes and frame configuration, and detailed inspections with observations, photos, treatments and actions. It offers batch inspections that step through an apiary in one session, plus a calendar for scheduling tasks across apiaries. Queen lineage, marking, performance and replacement history are tracked, along with honey harvests and equipment planning. The README also lists reports on colony health, QR codes for hive labels, invite-link sharing with other beekeepers, import/export of data, and an optional AI voice-inspection feature using self-hosted faster-whisper and Ollama. It can be installed as an offline-capable PWA, and includes an optional HiveHub (formerly HiveScale) device integration for weight, climate and sound monitoring.
use_cases: track beehive inspections and queen records
plan and schedule beekeeping tasks on a calendar
record honey harvests per hive and season
share apiary records with other beekeepers
use a beekeeping app offline in the field
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yaml with the app (ghcr.io/martinhrvn/hive-pal:latest) and a postgres:14 service, setting DATABASE_URL, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, FRONTEND_URL and STORAGE_TYPE
Development: git clone the repository, cd hive-pal, pnpm install
notable: AI voice inspections: records audio at the hive and drafts structured notes using self-hostable open models (faster-whisper and Ollama)
Batch inspections that guide a session through an entire apiary
Offline-ready installable PWA designed for field use
Free browser-based calculators such as syrup calculator, brood timeline and swarm management, with no signup
Optional HiveHub integration for monitoring self-hosted hive sensor devices
caveats: Self-hosting requires Docker plus a PostgreSQL database and several required environment variables (auth secret, URLs, admin credentials)
AI voice features depend on self-hosting faster-whisper and Ollama, which the README presents as optional setup
HiveHub integration needs additional configuration described in a separate integration document
